stemMd: For what value of k does the equation kx+6=3x+6 have more than one real solution?
explanationMd: Rearrange to (k−3)x=0. If k differs from 3, only x=0 works. If k=3, both sides are identical for every x, so there are infinitely many solutions.

distractorRationale.a: This forces x=0 rather than allowing multiple solutions.
distractorRationale.b: Only equal coefficients make the equation an identity.
